listing.description_html:
Month by month for three years: revenue, costs, burn and cash. See your runway, your break-even month, and whether you reach break-even before the money runs out, with a second scenario to compare.

This planner projects 36 months from a few assumptions you control: cash today, current monthly revenue and costs, and how fast each grows. It adds any one-off items you know about (a fundraise, an equipment purchase, a big contract) and calculates monthly burn, ending cash, your runway, your break-even month and whether you get there in time.

What's included

  • 36-month projection of revenue, costs, burn and ending cash from a few assumptions
  • Runway in months, break-even month, lowest cash and whether break-even comes before cash runs out
  • A second scenario next to the plan to test cost cuts, slower growth or price changes
  • One-off items for fundraises, loans, equipment and big contracts
  • Monthly status: OUT OF CASH, BURNING or PROFITABLE
  • PDF guide with a worked example comparing plan and scenario

Who it's for

  • Founders of bootstrapped and early-stage startups
  • Owners of small companies investing ahead of revenue
  • Agencies and studios planning a hire
  • Anyone preparing numbers for investors or a bank

You get: startup_runway_burn_planner.xlsx (Assumptions, Plan, Scenario, Summary) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a planning model, not financial, investment or legal advice. Projections are only as good as the growth and cost assumptions you enter; real results will differ.
